patients.summary: Healthy corporate project manager who joins in 2023. From early 2025 she has intermittent dysphagia and chest discomfort that fail a PPI trial; ENT calls it esophageal dysmotility, a barium swallow shows corkscrew contractions, EGD is normal and manometry in 2026 shows distal esophageal spasm managed without medication.

documents.body: Hi, I'm booked for my first appointment on 9/12. My old doctor's office said they can fax my records if you send them a request. Is there a form I should sign? Thanks, Abby Paquette

documents.title: New Patient Visit - Establish Care
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
43 y/o woman new to the practice, transferring for the membership model; her previous office was hard to reach by phone. Feels well. No active concerns today.

PMH: none. No surgeries. No hospitalizations.
Meds: none, no supplements.
Allergies: NKDA.
Family hx: mother - hypothyroidism. Father - essential HTN.
Social: project manager at a large company, long days at a desk, some deadline stress she describes as manageable. Never smoked. 1-2 drinks a week. No drugs. Walks most evenings.
Gyn: menses regular.
Health maintenance from prior records: mammogram 10/2022 negative, Pap/HPV 6/2021 negative (next co-test 2026), Tdap 5/2019.

ROS: negative across systems.

Exam: NAD, pleasant. HEENT clear, TMs normal. Neck supple, thyroid normal size without nodules, no adenopathy. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs CTA bilaterally. Abd soft, NT, no masses. Skin without suspicious lesions. Extremities warm, no edema. Neuro nonfocal.

A/P:
1. Adult preventive exam. Healthy. CBC, CMP, lipids. TSH given mom's thyroid disease. One-time hep C and HIV screens, she agreed.
2. Breast screening - mammogram ordered for October.
3. Flu vaccine today.
4. PHQ-2 0, AUDIT-C low risk.
Portal for results. Annual next September.

documents.title: Immunization
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Influenza vaccine 0.5 mL IM given L deltoid after screening questions reviewed (no prior reaction, not ill today). VIS provided. Tolerated well.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Abby - everything from Tuesday came back fine. Blood counts, kidney and liver numbers, cholesterol and thyroid are all in the normal range, and the hepatitis C and HIV screens were nonreactive. No changes needed. Mammogram order is in; radiology will call you to schedule.

documents.title: Pharmacy immunization record
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Immunization registry update from community pharmacy: COVID-19 2023-2024 formula vaccine given 10/06/2023. Added to immunization history.

reports.text: Bilateral digital screening mammogram with tomosynthesis. Comparison: 10/2022 from outside facility. Breast composition: scattered areas of fibroglandular density. No suspicious mass, architectural distortion or suspicious calcifications in either breast. Skin and nipples unremarkable.
reports.conclusion: BI-RADS 1: Negative. Routine annual screening recommended.

documents.title: Mammogram result

documents.body: Screening mammogram negative, BI-RADS 1. Result released to portal with a note that the next one is due in a year.

documents.title: Appointment rescheduled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt called, work travel this week. Cancelled 9/10 physical, rebooked 9/17 8:00. Lab draw same morning, fasting not required.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam. Abby has been well this year - no visits, no illnesses worth mentioning. Busy at work with a big rollout over the summer; sleeping okay. Still walking evenings.

Meds: none. Allergies: NKDA.
FH unchanged (mother hypothyroid, father HTN). Never smoker, light alcohol.

ROS: no chest pain, dyspnea, GI or GU complaints. Menses regular.

Exam: well-appearing. Vitals reviewed, BP normal. Thyroid without enlargement or nodules. No cervical or supraclavicular nodes. Cardiac exam regular, no murmur or rub. Lungs clear. Abdomen benign. No edema. Skin: no concerning moles on full check.

Assessment/plan:
- Well adult. CBC, CMP, lipid panel today.
- Mammogram due next month, order placed.
- Pap/HPV next due 2026.
- Colon cancer screening starts at 45 - will bring up next year.
- Flu shot given. Updated COVID shot at her pharmacy when it's out.
- PHQ-2 negative.
RTC 1 year.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Abby, labs from your physical look good - counts, chemistries and cholesterol all normal. Nothing to follow up on.

reports.text: Digital breast tomosynthesis screening, both breasts. Compared with 10/19/2023 and 10/2022. Scattered fibroglandular densities. No new mass, distortion or grouped calcifications. Stable appearance.
reports.conclusion: Negative (BI-RADS 1). Return for screening in 12 months.

documents.author: RN
documents.body: Mammogram 10/24 negative. Patient notified via portal. Recall set for 10/2025.
